Chapter 6929: Removed

Chapter 6929: Removed

They cared not about reputation and mentioned their grandmaster, one of the strongest primordial immortals in Heavenrealm.

Anyone would give him some face, more or less. Moreover, he was notorious for being murderous throughout the epochs.

“I’m aware, and?” Li Qiye smiled.

“If you spare us, we’ll be even. Otherwise, our branch will destroy your world and its inhabitants, no one will be left alive.” They hoped this would be effective since their grandmaster had destroyed more than a hundred worlds before. His number would put the immortals from Devouring Alliance to shame.

They did it to prolong life or increase cultivation. However, he did it out of wrath and retribution. Therefore, some feared him more than the devourers.

“Pop!” Li Qiye reduced them to blood.

Nevertheless, they could still scream since they were alive. He merely destroyed their body and sealed their true fate.

“Noo!” Their fate was no longer their own.

“I just happen to have some free time, and perhaps this Breaker Immortal deserves to die for what he has done.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Immortals, please give us another chance!” They begged.

“Pluff!” Li Qiye removed their ocean of consciousness from their virtually indestructible true fate. Once their memories were removed, their consciousness dispersed into nothingness.

Timeflow watched the power gap in horror. A mortal needed to crush an insect with a hand or foot. However, Li Qiye didn’t need to do so against three overlords. Timeflow found this inconceivable and nearly dropped to the ground.

“Pop!” Li Qiye directly found what he wanted to know.

“Immortal, did you find the location?” Timeflow asked.

“Yes.” Li Qiye smiled and blew a puff of air, extinguishing the sea of consciousness.

Timeflow heaved a sigh of relief after hearing this. Of course, a character of Li Qiye’s level wouldn’t have difficulties finding Perpetual Immortal. The most direct method was flipping all of Ancient over. However, the damages would be incalculable.

“Immortal, will you kill Perpetual Immortal?” He couldn’t help but ask.

“Depends on how many have a death wish. The more the better, eradicating some evil for the people.” Li Qiye said.

“...” He gulped and said: “Immortal, does that include Breaker Immortal?”

“If he’s blind, yes, and maybe the other primordial immortals in Ancient too.” Li Qiye smiled.

“Please don’t...” Timeflow became frightened.

“Oh?” Li Qiye smirked.

“Immortal, I swear that our branch is of the righteous path, we do not condone evil conduct.” Timeflow hurriedly said.

“I find that hard to believe for any overlord or immortal. Cultivation is going against the heaven, a fierce competition laden with death.” Li Qiye said.

“Well..” Timeflow couldn’t respond to that point and changed the subject: “Immortal, Breaker is at the peak of the primordial stage, even his peers have a hard time defending...”

“I can handle all three in Ancient at once.” Li Qiye said nonchalantly, freezing Timeflow in one spot.
